Method of Attack: Delivered via fake browser updates prompting users to download malicious files (HTA, JavaScript, Zip archives)
Malicious scripts gather system information and communicate with command and control servers
Selective payload delivery of banking trojans and backdoors
Use of freeware tool Nircmd.exe to capture and upload desktop screenshots
Impacted Systems: Enterprise customer networks infected via fake browser update sites
Attack Vector: Fake browser update prompts on hacked websites leading to malware download and execution
